RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraph.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraphLaw
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraph.type: {k N K : ℕ} → TimeProfile.Cuts k N K → PMF (RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N)
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraph.value: fun {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) => PMF.map RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraph.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraphLaw.eq_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraph.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraphLaw cuts = PMF.map RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldGeometr.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldGeometry_scan_test
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldGeometr.type:
∀ (k : ℕ) (eta ε : ℝ),
  0 < eta →
    0 < ε →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        1 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (rho chi xi : ℝ) (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
              (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
              RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
                (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G).card ^ (1 / 2 + RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 5) ≤
                        ↑(Finset.card
                            (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω ∩
                              RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges
                                (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N (RiffleLowerV2.coldRelativeSet cuts hN P W G)
                                  ↑(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.prefixAt W.ms G.ambient) ω))))) -
                    ε ≤
                  RiffleLowerV2.tv (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_collis.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_collision_mean_lower
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_collis.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {eta rho chi xi D : ℝ},
  0 < eta →
    ∀ (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k) (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
      RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
        D * ↑N ^ (-1 / 100) ≤ 1 / 2 →
          (∀ y ∈ RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G,
              |RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent y) -
                    RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y)| ≤
                D * ↑N ^ (-1 / 100) * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts y)) →
            RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldMeanConstant *
                ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.geometryG cuts hN P W G - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta) ≤
              RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount (RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G))

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_edges_.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_edges_threshold
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_edges_.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  1 ≤ N →
    ∀ {eta M : ℝ},
      0 < eta → 0 < M → M ≤ ↑N → M ^ (1 / 2 + RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 5) ≤ √M * ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 4)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_expone.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_exponent_slack
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_expone.type:
∀ {eta g h : ℝ},
  RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2 ≤ g - h / 2 →
    h / 2 + RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 3 + 19 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 150 ≤ g - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_half_m.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_half_mean_threshold
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_half_m.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    ∀ {eta M E : ℝ},
      2 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 12) →
        √M * ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 3) ≤ E → √M * ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 4) ≤ E / 2

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_mean_d.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_mean_dominates
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_mean_d.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  1 ≤ N →
    ∀ {eta M h g E : ℝ},
      0 < eta →
        0 ≤ M →
          M ≤ 2 * ↑N ^ h →
            RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2 ≤ g - h / 2 →
              2 / RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldMeanConstant ≤ ↑N ^ (19 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 150) →
                RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldMeanConstant * ↑N ^ (g - 4 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa0 eta) ≤ E →
                  √M * ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 3) ≤ E

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_mean_p.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_mean_power_lower
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_mean_p.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    ∀ {eta M E : ℝ},
      ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 3) ≤ M →
        √M * ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 3) ≤ E → ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 2) ≤ E

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_min_me.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_min_mean
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.cold_min_me.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  1 ≤ N →
    ∀ {z u κ₀ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ κ₀ → z ≤ 2 * κ₀ → Real.exp (-2) * ↑N ^ z ≤ u → Real.exp (-2) ^ 2 * ↑N ^ (2 * z - 4 * κ₀) ≤ min (u ^ 2) 1

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.collisionCo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.collisionCount_eq_card
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.collisionCo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (Y : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount Y ω = ↑{y ∈ Y | 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount y ω}.card

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.exists_cold.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.exists_cold_mean_threshold
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.exists_cold.type:
∀ (eta : ℝ),
  0 < eta →
    ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
      2 ≤ N0 ∧
        ∀ (N : ℕ),
          N0 ≤ N →
            2 / RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.coldMeanConstant ≤ ↑N ^ (19 * RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 150) ∧
              2 ≤ ↑N ^ (RiffleLowerV2.kappa eta / 12)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.finiteLarge.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.finiteLargestWordTV._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.finiteLarge.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (m : ℕ),
  2 ≤ m → ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts), ¬1 ≤ m → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.finiteLarge.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.finiteLargestWordTV._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.finiteLarge.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b : α}, (¬a < b) = (b ≤ a)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_forces_increasingRun
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m → m ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω → RiffleLowerV2.HasIncreasingRun (RiffleLowerV2.stableSort ω) m

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_forces_increasingRun._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m →
    m ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω ≤ N →
        RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω -
              RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω =
            RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
          ¬RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω + m ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_forces_increasingRun._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m →
    m ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω - RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω =
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
        ∀ (i j : Fin N),
          ↑j < RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω + m →
            i < j → ¬↑i < RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_forces_increasingRun._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (m : ℕ)
  (i j : Fin N),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω ≤ ↑i →
    i < j → ¬RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω ≤ ↑j → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_forces_increasingRun._proof_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.fullWord_fo.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m →
    m ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
      RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω - RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω =
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω →
        ∀ (i j : Fin N),
          ↑j < RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω + m →
            ¬↑j < RiffleLowerV2.upperRank (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) ω → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.geometry_se.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.geometry_selectedPiles
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.geometry_se.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) {eta rho chi xi : ℝ} (P : TimeProfile.BorelPartition k)
  (W : RiffleLowerV2.ColdWitnessData) (G : RiffleLowerV2.ColdGeometryData K P W),
  RiffleLowerV2.GeometrySpec cuts hN eta rho chi xi P W G →
    RiffleLowerV2.selectedPiles cuts (RiffleLowerV2.coldFullFamily cuts hN P W G) (min xi (min chi (1 / ↑k)))

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestCher.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestChernoffError_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestCher.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * ↑N ^ b)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean_uniform
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.type:
∀ (b epsilon : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    0 < epsilon →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        2 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (k K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
              ↑N ^ b ≤ RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN →
                1 - epsilon ≤
                  RiffleLowerV2.tv (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean_uniform_scales
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestMean.type:
∀ (b epsilon : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    0 < epsilon →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        2 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (mu : ℝ),
              ↑N ^ b ≤ mu →
                mu ≤ ↑N →
                  2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ∧
                    RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ≤ N ∧
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b) ≤ mu / 2 ∧
                        Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.chernoffConstant * mu) +
                            RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError N b ≤
                          epsilon

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestOnly.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestOnly._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestOnly.type: ∀ (k N0 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬1 ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.value:
fun (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ) =>
  ↑(N - RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b + 1) /
    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b).factorial

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError N b) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunError_tendsto._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunE.type:
∀ (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
  1 ≤ N →
    2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b →
      ¬N - RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b + 1 ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunL.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength_eventually_admissible
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunL.type:
∀ (b : ℝ),
  0 < b →
    b ≤ 1 →
      ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
        2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ∧
          RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b ≤ N ∧
            ↑(RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.largestRunLength N b) ≤ ↑N ^ b / 2

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_edge_event_implies_scan
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (H0 : Finset ℤ) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (δ : ℝ)
  (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  ↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ) ≤
      ↑(Finset.card
          (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω ∩
            RiffleLowerV2.internalEdges (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑(RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w ω)))) →
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess H0 δ (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_edge_event_implies_scan._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.localized_e.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Prefix k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w ω ≤ RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.upperRank w ω ≤ N →
    ¬RiffleLowerV2.lowerRank w ω < N + 1 → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.manyEdges._.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.manyEdges._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.manyEdges._.type: ∀ (k No Nm Nl Ns Ne N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬1 ≤ N → False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.maximalMean.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.maximalMean_le_population
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.maximalMean.type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N), RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN ≤ ↑N

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_eq.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_eq_actualGraphMixture
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_eq.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts =
    RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.pathGraphMixture (RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraphLaw cuts)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_la.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_lalley_test
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_la.type:
∀ (a δ D ε : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < δ →
      0 ≤ D →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            1 ≤ N0 ∧
              ∀ N ≥ N0,
                ∀ (k K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (H0 : Finset ℤ),
                  ↑N ^ a ≤ ↑H0.card →
                    (∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)).card ≤ D * √↑H0.card) →
                      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                            fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                            RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess H0 δ (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)) -
                          ε ≤
                        RiffleLowerV2.tv (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_sc.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_scan_success
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.physical_sc.type:
∀ (a δ D ε : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < δ →
      0 ≤ D →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ) (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (H0 : Finset ℤ),
                ↑N ^ a ≤ ↑H0.card →
                  (∀ (q : Fin (N + 1)),
                      ↑(RiffleLowerV2.boundary (RiffleLowerV2.clipTranslate N H0 ↑↑q)).card ≤ D * √↑H0.card) →
                    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                          fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                          RiffleLowerV2.Ascent.graphScanSuccess H0 δ (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)) -
                        ε ≤
                      RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts)
                        (RiffleLowerV2.scan H0 (↑H0.card ^ (1 / 2 + δ / 2)))

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ (a r c : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < c → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => ↑N ^ a * Real.exp (-c * ↑N ^ r)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 3] [NeZero 3], (3 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_7
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_stretchedExp_tendsto._simp_1_8
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.power_mul_s.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability_actualGraphLaw
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (A : RiffleLowerV2.PathEdges N → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.actualGraphLaw cuts) A =
    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      A (RiffleLowerV2.shuffleEdges ω)

RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.name: RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability_increasingRun_le
RiffleLowerV2.EmpiricalLower.probability.type:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  m ≤ N →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) fun (π : RiffleLowerV2.Permutation N) =>
